title: Estrelas da Casa Eliminations: Who Left the Reality Show This Thursday
seoTitle: Estrelas da Casa Eliminations: Who Left the Show Thursday?
subtitle: Japa, Arthur Belmonte, Enzo Cespom, and Laura Schadeck were eliminated on Festival night
excerpt: On Thursday (3), four singers exited Estrelas da Casa after public voting and mentor decisions. Find out who left and who was saved.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Festival night, held this Thursday (3), the musical reality show Estrelas da Casa determined which participants would leave the competition. The public voted for two singers from each genre, and then the mentors chose who to save.

Who was eliminated in pagode

From the pagode group, Japa and Arthur Belmonte were the contestants who left the show. Japa, originally from Aparecida de Goiânia, began his career singing in bars and private events. Arthur Belmonte, 29, lives exclusively from music, performing 15 to 20 shows monthly.

Who was eliminated in pop

In the pop segment, Enzo Cespom and Laura Schadeck were eliminated. Enzo, a 23-year-old from Rio de Janeiro, learned acoustic guitar at 15 and is part of a choir that performs Portuguese versions of international hits. Laura, a 23-year-old from Rio Grande do Sul, was part of the girl band BFF Girls and plays keyboard, piano, guitar, acoustic guitar, and ukulele.

Who stayed in pagode

The public chose Julliana Franco and Uel as the most voted in pagode. Julliana Franco, 30, is from Belém and has the song "Comigo" as her favorite. Uel, who served in the Navy, has "Só Depois" as his preferred song. Mentors Belo and Anitta saved Lukinhas, Hanaya, Esther Nunes, Dan Ferreira, Jefinho, and Vick Nunes, completing the team that remains in the competition.

Who stayed in pop

On the pop side, Tori and Bruno Gadiol were the singers chosen by the public. Tori joins the list of favorites along with Cinara, Álec, Gabriel Nandes, and Filgueira, who were selected by the mentors. Mentor Junior trusted Yudchi, Paula Tavares, Leonna, and Emma, while advisor Anitta ensured the permanence of Cinara, Yudchi, Álec, Paula Tavares, Gabriel Nandes, and Leona.

How the voting works

Viewers vote on the gshow portal to define two favorites from each genre. Then, the mentors – Junior (pop) and Belo (pagode) – and advisor Anitta decide who will be saved among the remaining contestants. The Estadão poll does not interfere with the official result, which only follows the gshow voting.

With information from Gshow, Estadão, NSC Total.
